caption: The handle of a wind-up torch is cranked, and the bulb brightens as the handle turns and fades when the cranking stops.

sa.check: A wind-up torch with a crank handle.
The bulb brightens as the handle turns.
The bulb fades when the cranking stops.
The bulb is dark before the handle moves.
The order is dark, crank and glow, stop and fade.

pc.expect: The bulb lights while the handle turns and fades within a moment of the handle stopping; it does not glow with the handle still.
pc.fail: The handle turns and the bulb stays dark to the end of the clip; or the bulb is lit before the handle moves; or the bulb stays bright long after the handle has stopped; or the bulb brightens after the cranking has stopped.

pc.expect: The handle turns only while the hand cranks it; it does not spin on its own or keep turning after release.
pc.fail: The handle spins by itself; or keeps turning after the hand lets go; or the torch spins with the handle; or the handle turns the other way by itself.

pc.expect: Once the cranking stops the fade runs one way to dark and does not brighten again without cranking.
pc.fail: The bulb brightens again with the handle still; or pulses on and off with the handle still; or goes dark and relights by itself.

pc.expect: While lit, the bulb throws a beam: the surface it points at brightens with it and dims as it fades.
pc.fail: The lens glows while the surface it points at stays as dark as before; or the surface brightens while the lens is dark; or the lit patch lies behind the torch.

pc.expect: One torch with one handle; the handle stays attached; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The handle detaches and floats; or a second torch appears; or the hand passes through the torch; or the torch changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The torch's colour and the surroundings stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The torch changes colour; or the handle changes shape; or the surroundings rearrange.

note: The hand is kept because cranking is the caption's cause; the person is otherwise not judged.
